mechanism: Magnesium supplementation may enhance amiodarone's antiarrhythmic and QT-prolonging effects, while hypomagnesemia increases risk of amiodarone-induced torsades de pointes and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum magnesium levels regularly in patients on amiodarone; maintain magnesium in normal range (2.0-2.5 mg/dL) and supplement if deficient to reduce arrhythmia risk.
